lecs.en: Role of the Teacher & Ethics in Nursing Education
lecs.ar: دور المعلم والأخلاقيات في تعليم التمريض

qs.q: The key responsibility of a nurse educator as a facilitator is to:
opts: Verify that educational standards are upheld
qs.ex: حسب البنك: دور المعلم كميسّر إنه يتأكد إن معايير التعليم متطبقة.

qs.q: Which of the following is a key role of a nurse educator as a researcher?
opts: Apply research results on new staff
Avoid integrating new research into practice
Evaluate outcomes and track learner progress
qs.ex: دور المعلم كباحث: يقيّم النتايج ويتابع تقدم الطلبة.

qs.q: The key role of a nurse educator in assessment and evaluation is to:
opts: Design valid and reliable assessment tools
qs.ex: في التقييم: يصمم أدوات تقييم valid وreliable.

qs.q: The main function of the teacher as a planner includes:
qs.ex: المعلم كمخطط: يحدد أهداف التعلم.

qs.q: The teacher should plan the learning tasks in accordance with the:
qs.ex: مهام التعلم بتتخطط حسب قدرات الطلبة واهتماماتهم.

qs.q: Which of the following is an ethical principle that guides nursing education?
qs.ex: من القيم الأخلاقية في تعليم التمريض (NLN): التميز (Excellence)، والتنوع، والنزاهة.

qs.q: Which teacher behavior suggests a dimension of an "unsuccessful" teacher? A teacher who is:
qs.ex: المعلم الفاشل: محافظ وروتيني، مبيجددش.

qs.q: The physiological barriers of communication include:
qs.ex: عوائق التواصل الفسيولوجية: المرض. المسافة عائق بيئي، والخوف نفسي، واللغة ثقافي.

qs.q: The teacher must use a nonjudgmental method with learners to:
opts: Assist the learner to identify his own style
Reduce the learner's anxiety about failure
Relate the learner's performance to goal
qs.ex: المعلم بيبعد عن الحكم على الطلبة علشان يقلّل خوفهم من الفشل.

qs.q: Learning can be inhibited by physiologic events. (True / False)
qs.ex: صح. الحاجات الجسدية زي التعب والألم ممكن تمنع التعلم.

qs.q: Which of the following is among the learner's barriers to learn?
opts: Starting teaching from simple to complex
qs.ex: القلق والخوف الشديد من عوائق التعلم.

qs.q: One of the following is a physiological barrier of the learner to communicate effectively:
qs.ex: عائق فسيولوجي: مشكلة في السمع.

qs.q: The teacher should use a nonjudgmental approach with learners to:
opts: Assist to identify his own style
qs.ex: علشان يقلّل الخوف من الفشل.

qs.q: A nurse educator can promote a culture of diversity, excellence, and integrity in the classroom by:
opts: Setting strict rules without allowing flexibility or student input
Encouraging open dialogue, modeling ethical behavior, and providing resources that promote fairness and equal opportunity for all students
Limiting access to resources based on students' academic performance
Focusing only on academic performance and ignoring emotional or social needs
qs.ex: نشجّع الحوار، ونبقى قدوة في الأخلاق، ونوفّر فرص متساوية.

qs.q: When dealing with learners from diverse backgrounds, a nurse educator should:
opts: Assume that all students have the same learning needs
Make decisions based on stereotypes of cultural or ethnic groups
Tailor teaching strategies to accommodate different learning styles and needs
Treat all students identically regardless of differences to avoid any perception of bias
qs.ex: نكيّف طرق التدريس على أساليب التعلم المختلفة.

qs.q: Which of the following is indicative of the quality of teaching?
opts: Period of maintaining peace in the classroom
Standard of questions raised by students in the classroom
Standard of answers replied by students
qs.ex: حسب البنك: مستوى الأسئلة اللي الطلبة بيسألوها بيدل على جودة التدريس.

qs.q: The key responsibility of a nurse educator as a facilitator is to:
opts: Avoid involving learners in the evaluation process
Verify that educational standards are upheld
qs.ex: حسب البنك: يتأكد إن معايير التعليم متطبقة.

qs.q: What role does the teacher play in the teaching-learning process?
opts: A passive observer of students' activities
Facilitates and directs the flow of the classroom
Provides resources for self-study for each student
qs.ex: المعلم بييسّر ويوجّه سير الفصل.

qs.q: Which of the following is the key teaching behaviour to make a teacher effective?
opts: Teacher's comments made for organizing the teaching process
Use of content or process questions by the teacher
Engagement of students in the learning process
qs.ex: المعلم الفعّال بيشرك الطلبة في عملية التعلم.

qs.q: The teacher must use nonjudgmental method with learners to:
opts: Reduce the learner anxiety about failure
Relate the learner's performance to goal
Assist the learner to identify his own style
qs.ex: علشان يقلّل الخوف من الفشل.

qs.q: Barrier to learning concerning norms and values is considered:
qs.ex: عائق متعلق بالقيم والعادات: ثقافي (Cultural).

qs.q: One of the following is considered as a learning barrier:
opts: Starting teaching from simple to complex
qs.ex: الدوشة الزيادة في المكان عائق للتعلم.

qs.q: A nurse educator modifies teaching for students with different cultural backgrounds. This reflects the NLN core value of:
qs.ex: تكييف التدريس للخلفيات الثقافية المختلفة: Diversity.

qs.q: Which teacher behavior is characteristic of an unsuccessful teacher?
qs.ex: المعلم الفاشل: محافظ وروتيني.

qs.q: Select ALL personal competencies of an effective teacher.
qs.ex: كفاءات المعلم: مهارات الاستماع والتواصل، والذكاء العاطفي، ومهارات العرض، والتحفيز. أما الحكم على الطلبة فلأ.

qs.q: A nurse educator collects data on students' outcomes to improve the curriculum. This is the role of:
qs.ex: جمع بيانات النتايج علشان يحسّن المنهج: دور الباحث والمقيّم.

qs.q: Why should the teacher use a non-judgmental approach?
opts: To reduce learners' anxiety about failure
qs.ex: علشان يقلّل الخوف من الفشل.

qs.q: Which is a physiological barrier to learning?
qs.ex: مشكلة السمع.

qs.q: Which learning theory supports the nurse educator's role in providing immediate feedback to reinforce desired behaviors?
qs.ex: الـ Behaviorism: التعلم بالتعزيز والتكرار، والـ feedback الفوري بيقوّي السلوك.

qs.q: Which intelligence is most relevant for a nursing student excelling in patient communication?
qs.ex: التواصل مع المرضى: Interpersonal intelligence.

qs.q: The key limitation of behaviorism in nursing education: مصادر2 تكرر في
opts: Ignores the role of internal mental processes
qs.ex: عيب الـ behaviorism: بيتجاهل العمليات العقلية الداخلية، وبيركز على السلوك اللي بيبان بس.

qs.q: Which learning theory focuses on how students process, store and retrieve information?
qs.ex: الـ Cognitivism: إزاي الطالب بيعالج المعلومة ويخزنها ويسترجعها.

qs.q: Which of the following is NOT one of Gardner's multiple intelligences?
qs.ex: ذكاءات Gardner: لغوي، وموسيقي، وطبيعي، وغيرهم. الـ Emotional مش منهم.

qs.q: Which study method would align with a right-brain learner's strengths?
opts: Creating a checklist to track progress
qs.ex: متعلم النص اليمين من المخ: خرايط مفاهيم ورسومات.

qs.q: The VARK model explains the concept of "learning preferences" as:
opts: Cognitive abilities not important in education
The ways individuals best process and retain information
Inherent characteristics that cannot be modified
qs.ex: الـ learning preferences في VARK: أحسن طريقة الشخص بيعالج بيها المعلومة ويحفظها.

qs.q: The VARK model suggests that when a learner is predominantly auditory, he might struggle with which task?
opts: Tutorials that rely on visual components
Interpreting written instructions without verbal explanations
qs.ex: المتعلم السمعي هيتعب لو التعليمات مكتوبة من غير شرح بالكلام.

qs.q: If, as a teacher, you set clear learning objectives and design repetitive practices, what theory of learning is evident?
qs.ex: الـ Behaviorism: التعلم بالتعزيز والتكرار، والـ feedback الفوري بيقوّي السلوك.

qs.q: The proper order of the key steps of social learning theory is:
qs.ex: ترتيب نظرية التعلم الاجتماعي (Bandura): Attention، بعدين Retention، بعدين Reproduction، بعدين Motivation.

qs.q: Which type of memory is responsible for procedural skills?
qs.ex: المهارات الإجرائية في الـ Implicit memory.

qs.q: In cognitivism, learning is explained by how a person:
qs.ex: الـ Cognitivism: التعلم بيتفسر بطريقة تفكير الشخص.

qs.q: Skinner's experiment drew our attention to which aspect of behaviorist learning theory?
qs.ex: تجربة Skinner: التعزيز بيقوّي التعلم.

qs.q: What is the main benefit for the learner to know his/her learning style?
qs.ex: لما الطالب يعرف أسلوب تعلمه يقدر يختار استراتيجيات مناسبة.

qs.q: A student was not allowed to participate in class activities because of his poor grades. This is known as:
qs.ex: منعه من الأنشطة بسبب درجاته: Punishment.

qs.q: Complete: Learners who remember conversations and enjoy reading text aloud are ......
qs.ex: اللي بيفتكر الكلام وبيحب يقرا بصوت عالي: Auditory learners.

qs.q: Complete: Learners who learn best by application of information are ......
qs.ex: اللي بيتعلم بالتطبيق: Kinesthetic learners.

qs.q: Complete: A biologically and developmentally imposed set of personal characteristics that make the same teaching method effective for some and ineffective for others is ......
qs.ex: صفات شخصية بتخلي نفس الطريقة تنفع مع ناس ومتنفعش مع ناس: Learning style.

qs.q: Complete: The ability to interpret and respond to the moods, emotions, motivations and actions of others is ......
qs.ex: فهم مشاعر الناس والتفاعل معاها: Interpersonal intelligence.

qs.q: Complete: The acronym that refers to the four types of learning styles categorized by sensory approaches is ......
qs.ex: الـ VARK: Visual، وAuditory، وRead/Write، وKinesthetic.

qs.q: The way individuals process information is defined as:
qs.ex: الطريقة اللي الشخص بيعالج بيها المعلومة: Learning style.

qs.q: Kinesthetic is a learning style that remembers by doing, moving and touching. (True / False)
qs.ex: صح. الـ Kinesthetic بيتعلم بالعمل والحركة واللمس.

qs.q: Learning styles refer to:
opts: Time when the learner expresses his interest
qs.ex: طريقة معالجة المعلومة.

qs.q: Visual learners process new information through:
qs.ex: المتعلم البصري: رسومات وصور.

qs.q: Which learning style is considered when the client demonstrates insulin injection?
qs.ex: التعلم بالعمل والحركة (زي إن المريض يعمل حقنة الإنسولين بنفسه، أو المحاكاة): Kinesthetic.

qs.q: Items can typically be stored in working memory (skills and procedures) for approximately how long?
qs.ex: الـ working memory بتحتفظ بالمعلومة حوالي 20 ثانية. أما الفترة غير المحددة فدي الـ long-term.

qs.q: Compared to the behavioristic orientation, the cognitive learning theory recognizes people as what type of learners?
qs.ex: الـ Cognitivism بيشوف المتعلم Active.

qs.q: The correct sequence of the observational learning process is:
qs.ex: التعلم بالملاحظة: Attentional، بعدين Retentional، بعدين Production، بعدين Motivational.

qs.q: The essential difference between negative reinforcement and punishment is that:
opts: Punishment decreases the behavior while negative reinforcement increases it
Individual performance contracts with each student
Reduce the amount of information to be stored in memory
qs.ex: العقاب بيقلّل السلوك، والـ negative reinforcement بيزوّده (بنشيل حاجة مزعجة).

qs.q: The primary difference between implicit and explicit memories is the amount of information that can be stored in each type of memory. (True / False)
qs.ex: غلط. الفرق بين الـ implicit والـ explicit في الوعي: واحدة بتتخزن من غير وعي والتانية بوعي، مش في كمية المعلومات.

qs.q: What are role models?
opts: Individuals who provide us with financial support and resources
Peers who we compete with in various activities and sports
Characters that influence our dreams and aspirations
Family members who we observe and imitate
qs.ex: القدوة (role models): شخصيات بتأثر في أحلامنا وطموحاتنا.

qs.q: Which of the following can best describe learning?
opts: Adopting problem solving strategy to enhance critical thinking
A relatively permanent change of behavior
Using motivation and reinforcement to ensure readiness to learn
Using a variety of innovative teaching
qs.ex: التعلم: تغيير نسبياً دايم في السلوك.

qs.q: Classical conditioning theory propounded by Ivan Pavlov explains learning by:
qs.ex: Pavlov: التعلم بالربط (association) بين مثيرين. أما التقليد فده Bandura.

qs.q: A ______ strengthens a behavior while a ______ decreases a behavior.
qs.ex: الـ Reinforcer بيقوّي السلوك، والـ punishment بيقلّله.

qs.q: "All human beings possess all nine intelligences in varying degrees" is a key principle of:
qs.ex: كل البشر عندهم الـ 9 ذكاءات بدرجات مختلفة: نظرية Gardner.

qs.q: Which of the following would best appeal to a right-brain learner studying science?
opts: Watching a summarized video about the topic
Creating an organized chart of scientific findings
qs.ex: متعلم النص اليمين: فيديو ملخص.

qs.q: In the VARK model, a learner who benefits from physical movement, hands-on activities, and simulations is classified as:
qs.ex: التعلم بالعمل والحركة (زي إن المريض يعمل حقنة الإنسولين بنفسه، أو المحاكاة): Kinesthetic.

qs.q: According to VARK, if a learner demonstrates an even preference for all four styles, the best teaching strategy is to:
opts: Focus primarily on one style that the learner enjoys
Develop a balanced and diverse approach to instruction
Limit instruction to written content and lecture formats
Provide only visual and auditory resources
qs.ex: لو بيحب الأربع أساليب بالتساوي: ننوّع طرق التدريس.

qs.q: Which of the following describes a left-brain learner's approach to solving a complex problem?
opts: Brainstorming a wide range of possibilities
Applying logical steps and a clear process
qs.ex: متعلم النص الشمال: خطوات منطقية واضحة.

qs.q: A student who prefers listening to lectures, discussions and podcasts, and excels at remembering spoken information, is most likely which type of learner in the VARK model?
qs.ex: بيحب المحاضرات والنقاش والبودكاست: Auditory.

qs.q: Which study habit aligns best with a visual learner's strengths?
opts: Using flowcharts and mind maps to organize information
Typing out essays to reinforce ideas
qs.ex: البصري: flowcharts وmind maps.

qs.q: A kinesthetic learner needs to study anatomy. What should they prioritize?
qs.ex: الـ Kinesthetic: يذاكر على موديل.

qs.q: How can a reading/writing learner best retain knowledge for an exam?
qs.ex: الـ Read/Write: يكتب المعلومة كذا مرة.

qs.q: Implicit memory is a type of memory that involves:
qs.ex: الـ Implicit memory: احتفاظ بالمعلومة من غير وعي.

qs.q: Which classroom activity would most engage a kinesthetic learner?
qs.ex: الـ Kinesthetic: لعب أدوار (role-play).

qs.q: The key limitation of behaviorism in nursing education: مصادر2 تكرر في
opts: Ignores the role of internal mental processes
Focuses on self-directed and life-long learning
qs.ex: عيب الـ behaviorism: بيتجاهل العمليات العقلية الداخلية، وبيركز على السلوك اللي بيبان بس.

qs.q: A spatial learner is tasked with analyzing data. What approach would work best?
opts: Discussing the data in a group
qs.ex: المتعلم المكاني (spatial): رسومات بيانية.

qs.q: The way that learner process information is called:
qs.ex: Learning styles.

qs.q: A client demonstrates insulin injection, this is considered which learning style:
qs.ex: التعلم بالعمل والحركة (زي إن المريض يعمل حقنة الإنسولين بنفسه، أو المحاكاة): Kinesthetic.

qs.q: Nurses must be aware of many learning styles to:
qs.ex: علشان نعرف نتعامل مع متعلمين مختلفين.

qs.q: Kinesthetic learners process new information through:
qs.ex: الـ Kinesthetic: باللمس والإحساس والعمل.

qs.q: Pavlov's classical conditioning explains learning through:
qs.ex: Pavlov: الربط بين المثيرات.

qs.q: Removing an unpleasant stimulus to increase a behavior is:
qs.ex: شيل حاجة مزعجة علشان السلوك يزيد: Negative reinforcement.

qs.q: Select ALL steps of Bandura's social learning in correct sequence elements.
qs.ex: خطوات Bandura: Attention، وRetention، وReproduction، وMotivation. الـ Assimilation من بياجيه.

qs.q: Which theory views learners as active processors who store and retrieve information?
qs.ex: الـ Cognitivism.

qs.q: A student who learns best using models and hands-on practice is a:
qs.ex: Kinesthetic.

qs.q: Procedural skills (e.g., riding a bike) are stored in which memory?
qs.ex: Implicit.

qs.q: The key characteristic of the educational process in nursing is:
opts: Being a systematic and planned course of action
Excluding the learner from the process
qs.ex: العملية التعليمية في التمريض منظمة ومخططة.

qs.q: What is teaching? Teaching is a process of ...... مصادر2 تكرر في
opts: Building strength to perform well on sports day
Attending to people's needs, experience and feelings
Helping others to grow physically and psychologically
qs.ex: التدريس عملية بتهتم باحتياجات الناس وخبراتهم ومشاعرهم.

qs.q: Which of the following best defines learning in nursing education?
opts: A passive process of receiving information
A process of relative changing of behavior
A process that does not require feedback
qs.ex: التعلم: تغيير نسبي في السلوك.

qs.q: The 'matter/content' in the teaching-learning process is significant because it:
opts: Is unrelated to the subject matter
Specifies what is to be learned based on objectives
qs.ex: المحتوى بيحدد إيه اللي هيتعلم بناءً على الأهداف.

qs.q: Which of the following is essential for establishing a conducive learning environment?
opts: A rigid structure with no flexibility
A focus on passive learning methods
qs.ex: جو محفّز وإيجابي.

qs.q: Which of the following is a limitation of concept maps in nursing education?
opts: They can be time-consuming to develop
They need more than one person
qs.ex: عيب الـ concept maps: بتاخد وقت تتعمل.

qs.q: A mind map can be used to analyze a patient case study by:
opts: Organizing visually patient data, diagnoses and interventions
qs.ex: الـ mind map بتنظّم بيانات المريض وتشخيصاته وتدخلاته بشكل مرئي.

qs.q: Which learning method is more appropriate for developing a nursing care plan and why?
opts: Mind map, due to its flexibility
Concept map, due to its structured methodology
qs.ex: خطة الرعاية: concept map، لأنها منظمة.

qs.q: A concept map can be used to identify gaps in a nursing student's knowledge through:
opts: Analyzing missing or incorrect connections between concepts
qs.ex: الوصلات الناقصة أو الغلط في الخريطة بتبيّن الثغرات.

qs.q: Which of the following indicates the importance of using a valid evaluation tool?
opts: Ensures the tool measures what it is supposed to measure
qs.ex: الأداة الـ valid بتقيس اللي المفروض تقيسه.

qs.q: Formative feedback is considered effective in nursing education when students:
opts: Receive average grades on summative assessments
qs.ex: الـ formative feedback نجح لو الطالب اتحسن في التقييم اللي بعده.

qs.q: The key participant in the teaching and learning process is:
qs.ex: أهم طرف في العملية: المتعلم (Learner).

qs.q: The element of teaching and learning that consists of purposeful, planned activities and tasks used by the teacher and learners to bring the intended outcomes is:
qs.ex: الأنشطة المخططة اللي توصّل للنتايج: Method.

qs.q: Relevance is a factor that affects the learning process as the client:
opts: Is actively involved in the learning process meaningfully
Takes feedback properly to support the desired goal
Connects new information with what is already known
Moves from simple to complex to understand
qs.ex: الـ Relevance: المتعلم بيربط المعلومة الجديدة باللي يعرفه.

qs.q: Benefits of health teaching include: مصادر3 تكرر في
qs.ex: من فوايد التثقيف الصحي: تعزيز الصحة.

qs.q: Formal communication means sharing information with friends and peers. (True / False)
qs.ex: غلط. مشاركة المعلومات مع الصحاب ده informal.

qs.q: Non-verbal communication includes: مصادر2 تكرر في
opts: Saying correctly what has been said
Using facial expression and bodily contact
qs.ex: التواصل غير اللفظي: تعبيرات الوش واللمس.

qs.q: An affective objective for an educational session about family planning is:
opts: Differentiate between different family planning methods
Compare between different family planning methods
State willingness regarding use of family planning
Give health knowledge about family planning
qs.ex: هدف وجداني (affective): «تعبّر عن استعدادها» تستخدم تنظيم الأسرة.

qs.q: Which one is a correct objective related to the cognitive domain?
opts: The students will apply dressing technique in a proper way
New mothers will feel less isolated and tensed
The learner will enumerate 5 causes of gastroenteritis
The mothers will perform breast self-examination
qs.ex: هدف معرفي: «يعدّد 5 أسباب».

qs.q: The act of decoding in the communication process is:
opts: Sender's conversion of message into symbols
Medium through which the sender conveys the message
Feedback given by the senders and receivers
Receiver's translation of message into an understandable form
qs.ex: الـ Decoding: المستقبل بيترجم الرسالة لشكل يفهمه.

qs.q: Which of the following is relevant to a learning goal?
qs.ex: الـ goal عام وواسع، أما الـ objective فمحدد.

qs.q: To facilitate retention of newly learned materials, the teacher should:
qs.ex: التكرار بيساعد على الحفظ.

qs.q: The affective domain is measured by an observational checklist. (True / False)
qs.ex: غلط. الـ checklist بالملاحظة بيقيس المهارات (psychomotor). الـ affective صعب يتقاس.

qs.q: Feedback is important in teaching to:
opts: Promote critical thinking to solve problems
Facilitate retention of newly learned material
Relate a person's performance to a desired goal
Connect new knowledge to what is already known
qs.ex: الـ feedback بيربط أداء الشخص بالهدف.

qs.q: One-way communication is suitable for: مصادر2 تكرر في
qs.ex: التواصل في اتجاه واحد مناسب للتعليمات البسيطة.

qs.q: For writing a measurable objective, the statement must:
qs.ex: الهدف القابل للقياس بيبدأ بفعل (action verb).

qs.q: The most difficult objective to be evaluated is:
qs.ex: أصعب هدف يتقيّم: Affective.

qs.q: Non-verbal communication includes: مصادر2 تكرر في
qs.ex: تعبيرات الوش ووضع الجسم.

qs.q: Which of the following educational objectives is an example of the affective domain?
opts: Perform breast self-examination on a doll
Calculate the correct number of fat grams
Display consistency in hand washing techniques
qs.ex: هدف affective: الالتزام بغسيل الإيد (سلوك واتجاه).

qs.q: ...... is the standard or criterion for judging the behavioral performance.
qs.ex: المعيار اللي بنحكم بيه على الأداء: Degree.

qs.q: The overall plan for a learning experience is considered as: مصادر2 تكرر في
qs.ex: الخطة العامة: Teaching strategy.

qs.q: The act of decoding in the communication process is: مصادر2 تكرر في
opts: Sender's conversion of message into symbolic form
Medium through which the sender conveys the message
Receiver's translation of message into an understandable form
Feedback given by senders and receivers
qs.ex: الـ Decoding: المستقبل بيترجم الرسالة لشكل يفهمه.

qs.q: Health ...... is a process that helps people to maintain healthy practices and life styles.
